summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests WS-CART-CS1, a CAR-T cell therapy that targets CS1 (SLAMF7), in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Participants have a leukapheresis procedure, then receive cyclophosphamide and fludarabine by IV on Days -5 to -3, and WS-CART-CS1 is infused on Day 0; hospitalization is 7 days. The study measures safety and preliminary anti-myeloma effects, but the primary outcome measure is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa WS-CART-CS1, una terapia con células CAR-T dirigida a CS1 (SLAMF7), en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. Los participantes se someten a una aféresis de leucocitos y luego reciben ciclofosfamida y fludarabina por vía intravenosa los días -5 a -3, y WS-CART-CS1 se infunde el día 0; la hospitalización dura 7 días. El estudio mide la seguridad y los efectos preliminares contra el mieloma, pero la medida principal de resultado no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after 3 or more prior lines of therapy.
Prior proteasome inhibitor, anti-CD38 therapy, and anti-BCMA therapy required.
Measurable disease by protein levels, biopsy-proven plasmacytoma, or bone marrow plasma cell criteria.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status of 1 or better.
Adequate kidney, liver, lung, and heart function, with LVEF of at least 45%.
not_for: Systemic myeloma therapy within 14 days before planned leukapheresis.
Other cancer history, except treated non-melanoma skin cancer or cancer treated over 2 years earlier with no evidence of disease.
Currently receiving other investigational agents, or cellular therapy within 8 weeks of conditioning.
Prior Grade 3 cytokine release syndrome or ICANS with other CAR-T therapy, including BCMA CAR.
Active hepatitis B or C, HIV, uncontrolled infection, pregnancy, or breastfeeding.
